title: PAR-49/7G.3 AC1024 paper-space delimiter owner
mode: Generated owner-closure regression and local sample trace
scope: Fix the observed false rejection of a BLOCK/ENDBLK pair whose parent handle is the owning paper-space BLOCK_RECORD.
Preserve strict rejection of mismatched nonzero owners and the existing BLOCK/ENDBLK reciprocal owner check.
Keep generated structural evidence distinct from end-to-end conversion and semantic support claims.

evidence.before: The existing sample failed in readDwgBlocks with BLOCK/ENDBLK owner does not match BLOCK_RECORD. Trace showed BLOCK_RECORD *Paper_Space handle 0x58 and *Paper_Space0 BLOCK/ENDBLK delimiters whose parent handle was 0x58.
evidence.after: The sample's DWG read reaches completion (operationSucceeded=true); export remains refused later because two OBJECT parses fail and SUN typed/raw carrier owner closure is incomplete.
evidence.formatBasis: Local authoritative ODA v5.4.1 PDF, §20.2 and §20.4.6–7; the former describes the legacy ownerless model/paper-space form, and the latter documents BLOCK/ENDBLK handle data.

implementation.rule: Accept a delimiter parent equal to the active BLOCK_RECORD handle. Also retain the existing ownerless form for names classified as model/paper space. Reject any other nonzero handle; still require BLOCK and ENDBLK owners to match each other.
implementation.generatedControl: An AC1027 in-memory writer emits BLOCK and ENDBLK named *PAPER_SPACE0, each parented to a *PAPER_SPACE BLOCK_RECORD; full readDwgBlocks publishes one complete scope.
implementation.testRegistration: Added focused libdxfrw_dwg_space_block_delimiter_owner CTest; no drawing fixture was added.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-49/7G.3: accept owner-bearing paper-space BLOCK/ENDBLK scopes when the handle matches their BLOCK_RECORD.
7G: keep owner/reference validation strict while distinguishing legacy ownerless space delimiters from valid explicit owner references.

validation.existingSamplePostFix: Read succeeds past the BLOCK/ENDBLK owner gate; conversion remains refused for distinct OBJECT parse and SUN carrier-owner closure failures.
validation.initialAc1024LabelBaseline: 0/31 before the fix; included a headless ODA converter abort and strict-export failures. Not rerun wholesale.
validation.diffCheck: PASS (scoped to CMake, reader, reader-matrix test, and plan files)

limitations: The generated control proves the local structural owner rule only; it does not qualify every paper-space version/name or downstream layout semantics.
The existing AC1024 sample is not fully converted: object types 528 and 515 fail parsing, and strict/partial export is refused by SUN carrier/owner closure.
No external drawing, peer implementation, native CAD application, geometry kernel, or platform qualification was run.
The change is uncommitted because the shared worktree has broad pre-existing modifications.
ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte-layout questions; all six external J items remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
